'''Lolo Essumon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Essumon lived on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Burnout (space station)|Burnout]], and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Kuce]] worked for him as a bodyguard. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Heroes of Cularin]] began searching the station for the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Xirossk]], and Essumon and Kuce confronted them, to find out what the heroes were up to.
